environment.executionContextEvidence: s_fastCapture=True; s_runPreservingContext=True; runtime probe initialized before suppression

measurementScope: Main-thread synchronous slices only. Scheduling and GetResult are separate. Async-method cases include builder work within those slices. PlayerLoop execution, suspended-frame time, continuation dispatch and builder completion during resumption are excluded. Async-method NextFrame cases run twice: with OnityTask.FlowExecutionContext on (unsuffixed) and off (suffixed 'flow off'); UniTask never flows the execution context. Raw times include harness overhead; no baseline subtraction or overall winner is inferred.
allocationCounter: GC.GetTotalMemory delta with GarbageCollector.GCMode disabled inside each measured slice; 64 KiB positive control and empty control passed. Process-wide, block granularity: read averages over many operations only.
allocationRejectedCandidates: per-thread counter skipped on IL2CPP after the DI harness observed crashes; profiler counter 'GC Allocated In Frame' is not valid
